blocks.text: You can manually remediate cloud alerts triggered for policy violations. You can remediate single alert, multiple alerts, bulk alerts, or all alerts triggered for a specific policy violation.
Ensure that write access is enabled for the cloud account to allow remediation. To learn more, see Configuring Write Access for an AWS Cloud Account.
You can only remediate alerts with an Open status or alerts whose remediation status is Failure.
To remediate alerts grouped by policy:

blocks.item: On the Alerts page, click the Cloud Alerts tab.
Click the Alerts Grouped By Policy tab.
Search for the policy you want to remediate.
Click the Actions icon () and select Remediate All.
In the Remediate Alerts window, enter the reason for remediation.

blocks.text: To remediate a single alert or multiple alerts:

blocks.item: On the Alerts page, click the Cloud Alerts tab.
Click the All Alerts List tab.
You can choose to remediate alerts from various locations in the Zscaler Posture Control (ZPC) Admin Portal:
In the Remediate Alert window, enter the reason for remediation.
Click the Actions icon (), then select Remediate.
Select the checkbox for an alert. You can also select and remediate multiple alerts. From the Actions menu that appears, select Remediate.
Click the Alert ID to view the alert drawer. From the Actions drop-down menu, select Remediate.
